title: EvoFlux: Inference-Time Evolution of Executable Tool Workflows for Compact Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.12674v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Small language models (1.5B-4B parameters) offer low-cost, low-latency tool use but often produce plausible plans that fail during execution due to unavailable tools, missing arguments, or broken dependencies. We introduce EvoFlux, an inference-time search method that repairs tool plans through an evolutionary loop over structured graphs of tool calls and dependencies. EvoFlux executes candidate plans against live tool servers and uses execution errors to guide targeted edits, including replacing tools, correcting parameters, inserting missing steps, and removing redundant ones. On held-out MCP-Bench tasks spanning 28 live servers and 250 tools, EvoFlux improves execution success from roughly 3% to 17-24% across four small planners. SFT and SFT+DPO trained on the same 177 demonstrations and 624 preference pairs match or underperform the zero-shot baseline, while ReAct reaches higher peaks on stronger planners at 4-20x greater planner

translated_title: EvoFlux：面向轻量级智能体的可执行工具工作流的推理时进化
translated_abstract: 小语言模型（1.5B-4B参数）能够以低成本、低延迟的方式使用工具，但其生成的计划虽看似合理，却常因工具不可用、参数缺失或依赖关系断裂而在执行时失败。我们提出了EvoFlux，这是一种推理时搜索方法，通过对结构化的工具调用与依赖关系图进行进化循环来修复工具计划。EvoFlux在真实工具服务器上执行候选计划，并利用执行错误引导针对性编辑，包括替换工具、修正参数、插入缺失步骤以及删除冗余步骤。在涵盖28个真实服务器和250个工具的MCP-Bench保留测试任务上，EvoFlux将四个小型规划器的执行成功率从约3%提升至17-24%。在相同的177个演示样本和624个偏好对上训练的SFT及SFT+DPO与零样本基线相当甚至更差，而ReAct虽在更强规划器上能达到更高峰值，但其规划器开销高出4-20倍。
tldr: EvoFlux是一种推理时进化搜索方法，通过在真实工具服务器上执行候选计划并利用执行错误迭代修复工具调用依赖图，无需微调即将1.5B-4B小型语言模型的工具执行成功率从约3%提升至17-24%，且优于同等数据下训练的SFT和SFT+DPO方法。
en_tdlr: EvoFlux is an inference-time evolutionary search method that repairs small LLM tool plans by executing candidate workflows against live tool servers and using execution errors to guide targeted graph edits, boosting execution success from ~3% to 17-24% without fine-tuning and outperforming SFT and SFT+DPO trained on the same data.
